title: FEATURE: per-topic unsubscribe option in emails

comments.text: "syntax: Typo: 'stopNotificiationsText' should be 'stopNotificationsText' (missing 'a' in 'Notifications')". Suggests renaming the function to stopNotificationsText.
"syntax: Typo in property name: 'stopNotificiationsText' should be 'stopNotificationsText' (missing 'n' in 'Notifications')". Suggests correcting the template's property reference.
Flags a possible nil pointer error: if no TopicUser record is found, tu is nil and later calls will crash. Suggests returning a 404 JSON error when tu is missing.
Raises a logic concern that email unsubscribe links usually work without login, but the new unsubscribe action is added to the authenticated actions list. Paraphrased; no code change suggested.
